$comment: S32 KSEB daily water levels (T114, D46). Today's readings only; no vertical datum asserted.

fields.meaning: KSEB; never conflated with irrigation dams of the same name

fields.name: district_code
fields.meaning: Published code, no inferred place or boundary mapping

fields.name: level_m
fields.meaning: Today's level in metres; unknown vertical datum

fields.name: storage_mcm
fields.meaning: Today's live storage, million cubic metres

fields.name: capacity_mcm
fields.meaning: Live storage at FRL, million cubic metres

fields.name: inflow_m3s
fields.meaning: Always null: upstream MU is energy, not discharge

fields.name: quality_details
fields.meaning: Unit conversions, datum limitation and quarantine explanations

observed_at: 07:00 IST on date_local, stored as UTC; also valid_at
available_at: Actual fetch time, never backdated to a report date
missing: Core measures are an atomic group under D23; missing or inconsistent rows retain identity but have null level, storage and capacity. Unsupported inflow and datum have independent reasons.
quality: Exact header and row width; level <= explicit MWL; positive capacity; nonnegative storage/percentage; percentage discrepancy <= 0.1 percentage points. No implicit unit repair.
history: Previous-year columns remain in raw evidence; not emitted as historical observations. Header-only report is a typed empty table, not zero levels.
